task_name: Site Handover, Topographic Survey & 14-Court Master Layout
estimation_rationale: ASBA court construction guidelines allocate 1.5 weeks upon lease handover for laser topographic survey, soil bearing tests, and finalizing 14-court (30x60 ft per court) + coaching + cafe blueprints.
To prevent post-21:00 neighbor noise complaints (Case Page 2 & 4), modeling perimeter STC-32 acoustic curtains and directional LED optics alongside 3-phase MEP schematics takes 1.5 weeks.

task_name: HCMC Construction Permit, Environmental & PCCC Fire Design Approval
estimation_rationale: In Ho Chi Minh City, interior/canopy fit-out notifications and Police Fire Prevention (PCCC Decree 50/2024/ND-CP) design tham duyet for commercial sports venues require 2.0 weeks.

task_name: Site Clearing, Sub-Base Compaction & Stormwater Drainage Grid
estimation_rationale: Excavating, installing HCMC monsoon French drains, and compacting crushed stone sub-base across ~3,200 m2 (14 courts + walkways) takes 2.0 weeks per commercial court builders.

task_name: Laser-Graded Vapor Barrier & Post-Tensioned Concrete Slab Pour (14 Courts)
estimation_rationale: Laying 15-mil polyolefin vapor barriers (essential in humid HCMC) and pouring laser-screeded 120mm post-tensioned concrete slabs across 14 courts in sequential bays takes 2.0 weeks.

task_name: [Mandatory Physics Gate] 28-Day Concrete Moisture Cure & Stress-Relief
core_deliverable: Hydration Cure to <3 lbs/1,000 sq.ft MVER
estimation_rationale: Every acrylic manufacturer (Laykold/SportMaster/ASBA) mandates a strict 28-day (4.0-week) concrete hydration and moisture-vapor curing period before applying non-breathable acrylic coatings.

task_name: High-Clearance Insulated Roof Canopy & Louvered Monsoon Windscreens
estimation_rationale: Erecting perimeter steel trusses, PU-insulated roofing (reducing HCMC afternoon court heat by 6-8 C), and monsoon rain louvers runs in parallel with slab pouring/curing across 4.5 weeks.

task_name: 3-Phase Electrical Grid, HVAC Ventilation & 500-Lux Glare-Free LED Lighting
estimation_rationale: Pulling armored 3-phase cables, high-volume low-speed (HVLS) circulation fans, and mounting 500-lux asymmetric anti-glare LED fixtures across 14 courts takes 4.0 weeks.

task_name: Specialty Cafe, Coaching Video-Analysis Studio & Locker/Shower Fit-Out
core_deliverable: Turnkey Cafe Bar, Coaching Room & Lockers
estimation_rationale: Per Case Page 3 ('14 courts, coaching facilities and a cafe'), building out the commercial espresso/electrolyte bar, coaching video analysis room, and tiled locker showers takes 5.0 weeks.

task_name: Slab Moisture Calcium-Chloride Testing, Diamond Grinding & Patch Leveling
estimation_rationale: Once the 28-day slab cure finishes at W8.5, ASTM F1869 moisture testing, diamond grinding, flood testing for 'birdbaths' (>1/8 inch ponding), and acrylic patch leveling take 1.5 weeks.

task_name: Multi-Layer Cushioned Silica-Sand Acrylic Surfacing & Precision Line Striping
estimation_rationale: Applying 1 adhesion primer + 2 rubberized cushion coats + 2 silica-sand texture color coats + laser-taped kitchen/baseline striping across 14 courts (with 24h dry times between coats) takes 3.0 weeks.

task_name: Perimeter Acoustic Noise Curtains, Court Divider Fencing & Net Systems
core_deliverable: STC-32 Sound Barriers, Fencing & 14 Pro Nets
estimation_rationale: Installing heavy-duty STC-32 mass-loaded vinyl acoustic perimeter baffles (-12 dB noise reduction for post-21:00 play), 10-ft court divider fencing, and 14 internal-wind net posts takes 2.5 weeks.

task_name: PCCC Fire Safety Final Inspection & Operating License Issuance
core_deliverable: Official HCMC PCCC & Sports Venue Operating Permit
estimation_rationale: On-site Police PCCC pressure/smoke alarm acceptance testing (nghiem thu PCCC) and ward operating registration require 1.5 weeks prior to public opening.

task_name: PICK! Social Platform, QR Turnstiles, Cafe POS & Automated Lighting Integration
core_deliverable: 20-Court Unified App Grid & Smart Lighting Relay
estimation_rationale: Because the PICK! Social & AdaptivePricing platform is already live since May 2027, onboarding Courts 7-20 into the Redis/Postgres grid and wiring QR check-in scanners + cafe POS takes 1.5 weeks.

task_name: Venue 2 Staff & Coach Recruitment, Training & 20-Court Grand Opening Tournament
core_deliverable: Trained 14-Court Crew & VIP Launch Event (End Jan-28)
estimation_rationale: Training front-desk, cleaning, cafe baristas, and certified coaches (including U-18 safeguarding) plus hosting a 300-player HCMC inter-university launch tournament completes Week 16 (end of Jan 2028).

task_name: Phase 1 Fill-Up (Months 14-16: Feb 2028 - Apr 2028): Member Migration & Off-Peak Ramp
core_deliverable: Ramp 14 New Courts from ~28% to ~60% of Steady-State
estimation_rationale: During the first 3 months post-opening (Feb-28 to Apr-28), existing PICK! Social members, peak waitlist overflow from Venue 1, and AdaptivePricing daytime discounts drive utilization to ~60% of steady-state.

task_name: Phase 2 Fill-Up (Months 17-21: May 2028 - Sep 2028): Full 20-Court Steady-State Maturity
estimation_rationale: Per Case Page 3 ('New clubs usually take six to nine months to fill up'), Months 4-8 of operation (May-Sep 2028) complete the smooth S-curve ramp to 100% steady-state 20-court utilization.
